notes.title: FOX XII Early Access Development Pillars
notes.content: [p]The image below outlines the core [b]Development Pillars[/b] and [b]Milestones[/b] on our journey toward a full 1.0 release. These goals are not presented in a fixed order — instead, [b]player feedback will help determine their priority[/b], shaping a flexible, timeline-based roadmap over time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654758/3358a975c28731ad8e0d9b44048775cf709a22f6.png"][/img][/p][p]Refer to the included [b]legend[/b] for details on feature progress status and implementation stages.[/p]
